audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed is called a knockup in six separate places — 'His R knockup is the kill threat', 'R-knockup combo', 'ult me airborne', 'R-knockup you mid-combo', 'His R-knockup arrives', 'one R-knockup off a Q-dash combo'.
audit.why: Fate Sealed does not knock up. Riot's text: Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls all enemies hit towards him. The knockup in his kit belongs to Mortal Steel's third cast, not the ultimate — the file has merged the two. The practical consequence is large: a pull that originates from BEHIND the last champion in the line means standing behind your own frontline is not safety, it is the exact spot he lands. A Mel player told it is a knockup will position for the wrong threat.
audit.corrected: Named Fate Sealed as a blink-behind-and-pull in spikes[1], spikes[3], wants.foe[2], whys[4], whys[6], phases[4].why, content.mid, content.late and loading.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yone.json (R Fate Sealed; dash flag only, no knockup)
champ-data/_kits/yone.json (Q Mortal Steel carries the knockup)

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] says to hold W for 'the spirit-cleave projectile' and content.late says 'take W to deny his big spirit-blade'. phases[1].why says the reflect turns his poke into Mel's poke.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave is a cone swipe, not a projectile, and Yone carries no projectile on any slot — Mortal Steel's third cast dashes him forward rather than firing anything, and Fate Sealed is a blink. Rebuttal's reflect has nothing to catch in this matchup, so its entire worth is the damage prevention. Three separate lines tell the player to hold her only defensive cooldown waiting for a projectile that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Rewrote every reflect line as damage immunity spent on Spirit Cleave's swing or the third Mortal Steel.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yone.json (no projectile flag on any slot)

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is called 'the clock this lane runs on' but the mechanic that makes it beatable is never stated.
audit.why: Yone's spirit is forced back to his body when the ability ends. The body does not move. That means the exact square he will occupy at the end of the window is known from the instant he casts — and Solar Snare is a 1000-range zone. This is the only reliable way an immobile mage lands CC on him, and it was missing while the file instead told her to 'track the cooldown'.
audit.corrected: Put the fixed-return-point counterplay into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, wants.you[2] and full.tldr, with the real 22/19/16/13/10 cooldown.
sources: champ-data/what-kills-me.js (yone line 1 states the same snapshot behaviour)

audit.whatIsWrong: Spirit Cleave is described only as a damage source; its shield and its attack-speed scaling are never mentioned.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave shields Yone, and the shield grows with the number of champions hit; its cooldown and cast time both scale with attack speed. For a poke mage that means two things the file never says: her chip is being eaten by a shield on a 14-second base, and as he itemises attack speed that shield arrives more often, not less. It also gives her a concrete instruction — force the cleave out before committing Golden Eclipse.
audit.corrected: Named Spirit Cleave and its attack-speed scaling in spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3], whys[2], whys[5], content.early, content.late and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing accounts for the fact that Yone spends no resource.
audit.why: Every Yone ability costs 0 — his resource is Flow, and Q, W, E and R are all free. Mel's Radiant Volley costs 70 mana at rank 1 and Solar Snare 50. In a long poke lane that asymmetry is the whole attrition problem: his whiffs are free and hers are not, so trading blind cooldowns with him is a losing exchange even when the damage looks even.
audit.corrected: Added the free-cast asymmetry to whys[3] and content.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carries no numbers at all, and tradeBad, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.trading claim Rebuttal is 'gone for twenty seconds'.
audit.why: Rebuttal is 38/35/33/29/26 — 38 seconds at the rank she has in lane, not twenty. Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10, Fate Sealed 120/100/80, Spirit Cleave 14 base. In a matchup the file itself frames as cooldown-driven, not one real number was present.
audit.corrected: Replaced the Rebuttal figure everywhere it appeared and filled breakdown.cooldowns with the real Yone numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and whys[5] both explain the first-item spike as 'his dash range now closes my Solar Snare gap'.
audit.why: Mortal Steel's dash range does not change with items — it is a fixed 450-range ability. What actually changes when he buys Berserker's Greaves and a crit item is attack speed, which shortens Spirit Cleave's cooldown and cast time. The file attributes the spike to the wrong mechanic, so a player watching for a longer dash will keep the same spacing and keep dying to the same shield.
audit.corrected: Re-pointed both strings at Spirit Cleave's attack-speed scaling.
sources: champ-data/_kits/yone.json (Q range 450 fixed; W cooldown and cast time scale with attack speed)

edits.before: I have a real window early — at Level 2 with Q and Solar Snare I can root him as he steps up for a minion and stack a free Q-poke on top, and he has no E-rewind escape yet to undo it. The trick is that his W spirit-cleave and third-auto Q-dash hit harder the longer he stacks marks, so I poke and back off, never standing in cleave range. Hold my W barrier for his dash-in auto or the spirit blade projectile, not for a stray poke. My root is my only CC, so if I whiff it I have nothing to peel his commit.
edits.after: I have a real window early — at Level 2 with Q and Solar Snare I can root him as he steps up for a minion and stack a free Q-poke on top, and Soul Unbound does not exist yet to undo it. The catch is Spirit Cleave: a 700-range cone that shields him every time it lands, so I poke and back off and never stand in cleave range. He owns no projectile at all, so my W is damage immunity, not a reflect — spend it on the third Mortal Steel. My root is my only CC, so if I whiff it I have nothing.

edits.before: From 4-6 the lane tilts toward him. I detonate R the moment he commits to punish the stacks I've built, but I cannot reliably kill him because his E undoes the bad trade. Play for poke chip and respect that one missed root is a death.
edits.after: From 4-6 the lane tilts toward him. My Q ranks up and Overwhelm builds from trades, but at 6 Fate Sealed blinks him behind the last champion in the line and pulls — 1000 range, 120s at rank 1 — and Soul Unbound lets him undo the trade afterwards. My Solar Snare is a single root I often won't have up for both his entrance and his exit. Worse, every ability he casts is free while my Q costs 70 mana, so his whiffs cost him nothing and mine cost me the next trade entirely.

notes: BIGGEST FIX: the file called Fate Sealed a knockup in six places. It is a blink behind the last champion in a line followed by a pull toward him — the knockup in Yone's kit belongs to Mortal Steel's third cast. The two abilities had been merged, and the resulting advice points the player at the wrong threat: against a pull that starts BEHIND the back of the line, standing behind an ally is the landing zone, not cover. SECOND: three lines told Mel to hold Rebuttal for 'the spirit-cleave projectile' / 'his big spirit-blade'. Spirit Cleave is a cone and Yone has no projectile on any slot, so the reflect is dead here and W is purely damage immunity. This same fault appears in mel/wukong and mel/warwick — the Rebuttal reflect is being sold in matchups where the enemy owns nothing reflectable, so it is worth sweeping the whole Mel file for it. THIRD: spikes[2] and whys[5] blamed the first-item spike on his dash range growing. Mortal Steel is a fixed 450 range; what actually changes is attack speed shortening Spirit Cleave. PHASE SIDES: all seven full.phases[].side read 'Yone' while content.win reads [Skill,Mel,Mel,Skill,Skill,Skill,Yone]. The difficulty rating itself is right so I left it, but the two Mel entries in the content chart have no counterpart in the full layer. LEFT ALONE: content.mid calls Solar Snare 'a single 1.5s root'. The kit file does not carry root duration and I could not verify 1.5s, so I did not repeat the number in anything I rewrote and did not touch that claim. WKM_LINES for yone, yasuo, warwick, wukong, zac and zaahen all check out against the kit files — no errors to report there.
